messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: PAGER - inference-prod p95 latency > 1200ms for 5m. Paging on-call. link: https://ops.redwood.ai/alerts/INC-1234 :rotating_light:
Alex G.: I'm on it, grabbing context. @Priya S. can you confirm customer impact? Any 5xx spike?
Priya S.: seeing increased tail latencies on /v1/generate for model rwd-7b-quant, error rate still low (0.3%). A handful of premium tenants reported timeouts. Getting stack traces now.
Marco T.: I can try to scale dedicated pool up +1 node, but warmup takes ~90s. Suggest immediate mitigation: set routing policy to fallback variant rwd-7b-fp16 for non-enterprise tenants.
Lina R.: +1. Also reduce batching window from 50ms -> 10ms to cut tail. I'll push a patch to runtime config.
Alex G.: Marco, can you toggle the routing? Lina, make change and post the config diff.
Marco T.: done, routing policy rollout started: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/redwood/routes -d '{ \"route\":\"fallback\", \"scope\":\"non-enterprise\" }'` -> accepted. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy 2026.03.15.13:42 by Marco T. started -> warmup logs: `gpu_mem ok, kv cache primed`
Lina R.: patch pushed, batching_window_ms: 50 -> 10 in config, rolling restart for runtime d0-d3. Snippet:
```
serving:
  batching:
    window_ms: 10
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
```
Alex G.: early results: p95 dropped from 1250ms -> 680ms on non-enterprise tenants. Enterprise still high. Priya, do we want to silence the paging rule to reduce noise while we stabilize?
Priya S.: yes please. I'll mute the alert for 30m and create a follow-up to re-evaluate thresholds.
Priya S.: Mute done. Note: add a separate rule for enterprise traffic with stricter thresholds.
Alex G.: Ok next: post-incident ops item: build a Grafana 'incident retrospectives' dashboard. Requirements brainstorm:
- Golden signals: latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, requests/s
- Serving signals: queue length, batch size distribution, avg batch wait
- Hardware: GPU util, memory, PCIe errors
- Model routing: percentage traffic per model variant, KV cache hit ratio
- Drilldowns to traces (tempo) and runbooks
- Panels with ability to filter by tenant and timeframe
Priya S.: I'll start a dashboard skeleton. Anyone have preferred panel types? I like histogram for batch size, heatmap for latency by seq len.
Marco T.: Add a panel that shows latency percentiles overlayed with rolling deploy events. Also include a 'blame map' that links errors -> model versions.
Lina R.: +1. Also add an "alert noise" panel: count of firing alerts over time and suppressed alerts.
Alex G.: Also we should add a 'postmortem checklist' panel linking to confluence and list actionable alerts.
Priya S.: quick config for a Prometheus alert we'd like to tune (example):
```
- alert: InferenceHighP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job)) > 0.8
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "p95 latency high on {{ $labels.job }}"
```
Marco T.: Suggest change: split by tenant_tier label, and add `unless` clause for cache priming windows. e.g.
```
expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, ... ) > 0.8) and on(tenant_tier) tenant_tier != \"enterprise\"
```
Lina R.: For dashboard panels, here's a small Grafana panel JSON snippet I'll use as template:
```
{
  "title": "p95 latency",
  "type": "stat",
  "targets": [{ "expr": "histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))" }]
}
```
Alex G.: Nice. Action items:
- Priya S.: create dashboard seed (skeleton panels) and link runbooks -> due today EOD
- Marco T.: build routing fallback Canary and document rollback -> 2h
- Lina R.: send alert tuning PR (split enterprise/non-enterprise, reduce flapping) -> 1h
- Alex G.: compile customer impact note for CS -> 30m
Priya S.: starting dashboard seed now. I'll include panel drilldowns to traces + tenant filter. Posting workspace link when ready.
Alex G.: thanks all. I'll mark incident status: mitigated, monitoring. We'll run a brief retro with product tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident INC-1234 status updated -> mitigated by manual routing & batching changes. Duration: ~22m :white_check_mark:
Priya S.: dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd1234/incident-retro — please review, commenting on panels.
Marco T.: left comments on memory usage graph. Noted we'll add more labels to metrics for per-tenant breakdown.
Lina R.: creating alert PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops/commit/abcdef — includes enterprise split and 30m suppression param.
Alex G.: Good job team. Postmortem owners: Priya (dashboard + customer impact), Marco (routing + infra), Lina (alerts). I'll schedule retro invite.
Priya S.: adding "lessons learned" section in dashboard with TODO checkboxes.
Alex G.: closing thread. :v:
